DEC 10,2025—

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial
District symbols as shown on Map No. 2-H

in the area bounded by:

A line 25 feet south of West Grenshaw Street; a line 82.5 feet east of South Western

Avenue; a line 50 feet south of West Grenshaw Street; South Western Avenue.

To those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 1137S. Western Avenue
